# laravel_cloud_websocket_server_types (Data Source)

Lists the WebSocket server types, with the regions and max connection tiers each supports. Use a tier's value as max_connections on laravel_cloud_websocket_server.

~> This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_websocket_server_types" "all" {}

# The max_connections tiers the organization's plan includes for Reverb.
locals {
  reverb_tiers = [
    for tier in one([for t in data.laravel_cloud_websocket_server_types.all.types : t if t.type == "reverb"]).max_connections :
    tier.value if tier.available
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `types` (Attributes List) WebSocket server types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the organization can create servers of this type.
- `label` (String) Display name.
- `max_connections` (Attributes List) Max connection tiers, smallest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types--max_connections))
- `regions` (List of String) Regions the type is offered in.
- `type` (String) Type identifier, such as `reverb`.

<a id="nestedatt--types--max_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types.max_connections`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the organization's plan includes this tier.
- `label` (String) Display label.
- `value` (Number) Value to pass as max_connections.
